newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures slightly lower in choppy trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures slightly lower in choppy trade.

text.p: May 1 - U.S. debt futures were slightly lower in early choppy trading. June T-bond bounced briefly after latest U.S. weekly jobless claims rose to 347,000 from a revised 319,000 in the prior week. The trade had expected 325,000. March personal income rose 0.6 pct, spending up 0.5 percent, versus forecasts for up 0.4 and 0.5, respectively.
